about: Tests/MakingOfTests/Fixtures/show-small composited by making_of_compose.Compositor (float32, as the clip tool runs it); written by tools/tests/test_making_of_layers.py --write-goldens. The moments are 0.3 s, a quarter and 70 % into each step, and 0.9 s after the last step. Field k of FIELDS is (intro + k step + 0.1 + (step - 0.4) u) with u = 0.5 + 0.5 sin(2 x/w + 3.1 y/h + 1.7 k), rounded to 1/4096 s (so no libm's sine can move it) and kept as float32; ink is ((x + 2 y) mod 7) / 6.
